main_text.p: זְמָרָא Chald. Musica: כָּל־זְנֵי זְמָרָא Omnis generis mulices, Dan.3.5.

זְמָר f. Palmes, Surculus, Propago; sic dicta, quòd Putari solet, Num.13.24. אֶת־הַזְּמֹרָה Surculos, Ezech.8. v.17. Constr. זְמֹרַת זָר Et palmite extraneo, Jesa.17.10. Plural. cum Aff. וּזְמֵרֵיהֶם Et palmites eorum, Nah.2.2. At Ezech.8.17. juxta Hebr. est Fœtor, Odor malus ventris, Crepitus ventris, quomodo ignominia causâ vocat Suffitum in Templo.

זְמָרָה f. Psalmodia, Cantus, Carmen; Psalmodica instrumenta: Et in loco הּ, וּזְמָרָה Et carmen, Jesa.12.2. Psalm.118.14. Constr. מְזִמְרַת הָאָרֶץ De cantione terræ Genes.43.11. id est, rebus laudatissimis terræ, quæ decantari solent.
זְמִירָה f. Cantio, Psalmus: Plural: זְמִירוֹת Cantiones; Job.35.10.
מִזְמֹרוֹת f.p. Falces putatoriæ, Jes.18.5. Aff. וּמִזְמְרוֹתֵיכֶם Et falces vestras, Joël.4.10.

זֵן Chald. Species: pro Hebræo מִין sæpe in Targum ponitur: Plural. Constr. כָּל זֵנֵי Omnes species, Dan.3.v.5. Hinc, juxta quosdam, in Hebræo מִזֵּן אֶל זֵן De specie in speciem, id est, Omnis generis commeatus, varia annonæ genera; de quo etiam suprà in זֵן: Plural. וּזְנֵיכֶם Et species, 2.Par.16.14.
זָנָב m. Cauda, Jud.15.4. Aff. זְנָבוֹ Caudam suam, Job.40.12. Plurale terminationis fœmin. sed generis masc. בֵּין שְׁנֵי הַזְּנָבוֹת Inter duas caudas, Jud.15. v.4. Constr. זִנְבוֹת Jesa.7.4.
זָנַב Pih. Decaudare, Caudâ truncare. Præteritum, וְזִנַּבְתָּם אוֹתָם Et decaudabit eos, id est; extremos cæde-

page.notes: The hyphenated word "cæde-" continues as "tis" at lower right; that word is given as the catchword. Hebrew glyphs are transcribed from the scan and some vowel points are uncertain; the running head is uncertain. No marginal notes on this page.
